title: How Many Apples? 🍎 Count with Pip! #shorts
description:
Count the apples with Pip the little chick! One, two, three! A tiny Buttercup Hollow learning story for toddlers.

#shorts #countingforkids #toddlerlearning #preschool

scenes.image_prompt: Pip the tiny yellow chick looking up in surprise at a big apple tree full of red apples, low angle
scenes.motion_prompt: the chick looks up in amazement and flaps its little wings

scenes.image_prompt: one red apple on the grass in front of Pip the chick
two red apples on the grass in front of Pip the chick, who is smiling
three red apples on the grass, Pip the chick hugging them happily

lines.text: One, two, three! Can you count with me?

scenes.image_prompt: Bo the baby elephant gives Pip the chick a high five next to three red apples
scenes.motion_prompt: the elephant and the chick do a happy high five
